description: flick --host <mac> hangs: TCP connects but remote status shows last connection: none (flick-net threads stuck in poll). macOS Application Firewall on that Mac holds connections to an ad-hoc-signed Flick, even when socketfilterfw lists it permitted. Check socketfilterfw --getglobalstate and codesign -dvv there.
resolution: Sign with an Apple Development identity (import Apple WWDR G3 intermediate or the identity is invalid), then socketfilterfw --remove/--add/--unblockapp once; the rule survives rebuilds. Headless Mac: bundle.sh over ssh fails with errSecInternalComponent (locked keychain); update with 'flick flick rebuild', which signs inside the GUI session.
